sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('pharmacia upjohn', 'inforlife for sandoz', 'bryant ranch prepack', 'bausch health companies', 'sandoz', 'bausch health') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%clindamycin%' ORDER BY initiation_date
